title: The Last Keeper of the Lighthouse
explanation: For years the lighthouse burned the same light — until one night it went out on its own.
content:
The sea was quieter that night than it had ever been. As Cevat climbed the stairs, he mistook their creak for his own heartbeat. Forty years he had kept this light, and for forty years it had never once faltered.

The word behind the dark

Mira waited below, at the end of the pier. The wind pulled at her hair, but her eyes never left the horizon — as if the dark had swallowed something that ought to return.

“A lighthouse never dies,” his father had said. “It only hands over the watch.”

He laid his hand on the glass. It was cold. The flame within trembled, hesitant for a moment, then went out with quiet certainty. For the first time in its history, the town stood without light.

And into that emptiness came an answer from across the water. A small, stubborn light. As if someone, after all these years, had decided to come home.
